narrative.overview: This page carries no page-specific design system: its content stylesheets 404 on the live origin, so headings, lists, and body copy render in the browser's default UA styles (Times New Roman) inside a fixed non-responsive column, while the shared FedEx header/footer component supplies the only intentional, responsive, branded styling.
keyCharacteristics: Two unrelated visual registers: branded responsive chrome vs. unstyled fixed-width body
Body-content register is a captured defect (404'd stylesheet), preserved verbatim per the replica contract
dos: Do leave the body-content region unstyled (browser defaults)
Do keep the body-content column at a fixed 990px width
donts: Don't apply a design system to the body-content region beyond browser defaults
Don't fix the 404'ing content stylesheet without a register entry
